Class VertexAiApiException

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Throwable
java.lang.Exception
java.lang.RuntimeException
com.google.adk.sessions.SessionException
com.google.adk.sessions.VertexAiApiException
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class VertexAiApiException extends SessionException
Signals a non-2xx, non-404 HTTP status from the Vertex AI Session API. Extends SessionException so existing catch (SessionException) call sites still work.
